usage: MergeVcf.py [-h] [--platform PLATFORM] [--ref_fn REF_FN]
                   [--pileup_vcf_fn PILEUP_VCF_FN]
                   [--full_alignment_vcf_fn FULL_ALIGNMENT_VCF_FN]
                   [--gvcf GVCF] [--non_var_gvcf_fn NON_VAR_GVCF_FN]
                   [--gvcf_fn GVCF_FN] [--output_fn OUTPUT_FN]
                   [--ctgName CTGNAME] [--ctgStart CTGSTART] [--ctgEnd CTGEND]
                   [--bed_fn_prefix BED_FN_PREFIX] [--qual QUAL]
                   [--sampleName SAMPLENAME] [--samtools SAMTOOLS]
                   [--print_ref_calls PRINT_REF_CALLS]
                   [--haploid_precise HAPLOID_PRECISE]
                   [--haploid_sensitive HAPLOID_SENSITIVE]

Generate 1-based variant candidates using alignments

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --platform PLATFORM   Sequencing platform of the input. Options:
                        'ont,hifi,ilmn', default: ont
  --ref_fn REF_FN       Reference fasta file input
  --pileup_vcf_fn PILEUP_VCF_FN
                        Path to the pileup vcf file
  --full_alignment_vcf_fn FULL_ALIGNMENT_VCF_FN
                        Path to the full alignment vcf file
  --gvcf GVCF           Enable GVCF output, default: disabled
  --non_var_gvcf_fn NON_VAR_GVCF_FN
                        Path to the non-variant GVCF
  --gvcf_fn GVCF_FN     Filename of the GVCF output
  --output_fn OUTPUT_FN
                        Filename of the merged output
  --ctgName CTGNAME     The name of sequence to be processed
  --ctgStart CTGSTART   The 1-based starting position of the sequence to be
                        processed
  --ctgEnd CTGEND       The 1-based inclusive ending position of the sequence
                        to be processed
  --bed_fn_prefix BED_FN_PREFIX
                        Process variant only in the provided regions prefix
  --qual QUAL           If set, variants with >$qual will be marked 'PASS', or
                        'LowQual' otherwise, optional
  --sampleName SAMPLENAME
                        Define the sample name to be shown in the VCF file
  --samtools SAMTOOLS   Path to the 'samtools', samtools version >= 1.10 is
                        required, default: samtools
  --print_ref_calls PRINT_REF_CALLS
                        Show reference calls (0/0) in vcf file output
  --haploid_precise HAPLOID_PRECISE
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Enable haploid calling mode. Only 1/1 is
                        considered as a variant
  --haploid_sensitive HAPLOID_SENSITIVE
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Enable haploid calling mode. 0/1 and 1/1
                        are considered as a variant
